purpose: Diagnose the fixed transformer's persistence deficit and compare small linear baselines without changing or retraining the transformer
objective: mean squared error plus penalty times squared coefficient norm; unpenalized fitted intercept
input_arithmetic: Original observations rounded to FP32, then FP64 linear algebra; fixed training-only FP32 feature scales repeated over 96 lags; center predictors/targets using training windows only
selection: lowest validation MAE within each of four families; smaller penalty wins an exact tie; report all 16 candidates
transformer_selection: Use only the three previously sealed validation-selected v1 checkpoints; no retraining, calibration or test-based seed selection
movement_buckets: Fit absolute actual one-hour-change thresholds on training targets using linear quantiles; low <= q50, middle q50 < change <= q90, high > q90
test_status: Previously inspected v1 test period; retrospective exploratory comparison, not a new untouched confirmation
reserved_tail: Rows 57600 onward: hashes/schema/clocks may be verified as part of the pinned source, but no outcomes, predictions, features or fitted statistics are computed there
failure_policy: Abort on missing/changed sealed models, invalid source/scaler, nonfinite values, invalid eigen decomposition, or unannounced protocol changes; retain partial run and failure record
limitations: No fresh statistical confirmation or trading evidence
No IID p-values for overlapping forecasts
Movement groups use actual future change for description only, not an actionable selection rule
An anchored linear model tests a regularization prior; it does not prove that changing a transformer head will help
